job_function: trade lifecycle operations - OTC confirmation and portfolio reconciliation
control_point: OTC derivative trades are confirmed with counterparties and portfolio reconciliations are performed on economic terms, with breaks escalated under ISDA trade-matching and reconciliation guidance; the control point is the comparison of internally booked trade data against the counterparty affirmation and portfolio reconciliation statement.

citations.source_name: CFTC Regulation 23.501 – Confirmation requirements for swap transactions

consequence_anchor.public_source: CFTC/SEC and ESMA rules requiring timely confirmation and portfolio reconciliation, plus ISDA best-practice guidance on break escalation
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: regulatory fine per late or unconfirmed trade and remediation cost scaling with backlog age and notional volume

commonality_rationale: OTC confirmation and portfolio reconciliation are daily, cross-asset operations for every dealer and major end-user; public rule deadlines and ISDA documentation make the control point independent of any single institution.
